ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominance of high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across approximately 60% of the distal lobes, with a high-contrast transition to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels concentrated in the central median region and trailing edge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized low-intensity contiguous mass spanning the median notch area. High-contrast, irregular dark mottling (blobs) scattered across the high-intensity surface of both lobes, with higher density of focal spots located towards the trailing edge boundaries.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 115 degrees and a shallow bounding-box depth relative to the total lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire visible boundary. Pixel-amplitude variations are most pronounced at the distal tips, featuring jagged peaks and deep valleys compared to the smoother medial sections.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curvature extending from the median notch to the distal tips, forming a swept-back 2D profile.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple localized circular low-intensity clusters (5-12 pixel diameter) distributed across the mid-section of the right lobe and near the trailing edge of the left lobe, consistent with barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned diagonal linear pixel disruptions visible on the medial-inner region of the left lobe, cutting through the primary pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular raggedness and minor tissue loss visible at the far-left distal tip of the fluke lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'salt-and-pepper' mottling pattern characterized by sharp boundaries between high and low intensity pixels across the distal surface area.
